# Evalve Consulting

> Most needs. Fewest minutes. Start there. I help teachers and school leaders use AI to get time back, starting with the classrooms that need the most and have the least time. I'm Dr. Chris Sanzeri, founder of Evalve Consulting. Based in the Chicago area (Wheaton, Illinois), I work with schools across Illinois and remotely nationwide.

I don't hand you a slide deck. I build the tool with you and show your staff how to use it. I spent nine years as an administrator in a large Illinois school district, supporting more than 1,400 staff and helping teams start using AI safely. Today I teach special education, so I try every tool with students before I recommend it. Some of my tools run on my own computer, so private information never goes to an outside company.

## About

- **Founder:** Dr. Christopher (Chris) Sanzeri, Ed.D. in Education Leadership. I spent nine years as an administrator in a large Illinois school district, supporting more than 1,400 staff. I have delivered 100+ professional learning sessions and built tools used by hundreds of educators.
- **Special education:** My background is K-12 leadership and special education. Special education taught me to handle the most paperwork-heavy, privacy-sensitive work in a school, and I bring that same care to every department.
- **Location:** Based in the Chicago area (Wheaton / Chicagoland, Illinois). I serve Illinois and the United States nationwide, and most of the work can happen over video.

## Who I serve

School districts, Regional Offices of Education, education cooperatives, universities and higher ed groups, edtech companies, curriculum publishers, nonprofits that serve schools, state education agencies, and K-12 leadership teams who want to start using AI safely.

## Services

- **Quick Win:** a short try for one problem from your week, like parent emails or sub plans. It starts with a free 30-minute call. Includes a focused look at the need, one problem solved end to end, a check that a tool is safe for students, and 30-day email support.
- **Deep Implementation:** for teams ready to make AI part of a normal week. I train your staff, build the tools with you, and stay with you while you use them. A grade-level team gets a shared set of lesson-planning helpers and a monthly check-in to fix what isn't working.
- **Ongoing Partnership:** for a school or district that wants that help through the year. Training, the tools we build together, and a check-in when something stops working.

## Free resources

- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://evalveconsulting.com/ai-readiness/): a short look at where your school is starting from.
- [Invisible Work Audit](https://evalveconsulting.com/workflow-audit/): list the tasks that eat your week and get a short list of the ones a tool could take off your plate first.
- [AI-in-Education Job Board](https://evalveconsulting.com/jobs/): a weekly, curated drop of open AI roles in K-12 districts, edtech, Regional Offices of Education, and higher ed. Updated every Tuesday.
- [District AI Pilot Checklist](https://evalveconsulting.com/pilot-checklist/): a 90-day map for a small try-out with a few teachers before everyone uses a tool.

## Products

- [Digital products](https://evalveconsulting.com/products/): ready-to-use AI instructions, workflow recipes, and planning workbooks for education teams.

## Apps

- [Apps](https://evalveconsulting.com/apps/): iPhone and iPad apps I built. Behavior and Goal Tracker (behavior and IEP goal data collection for educators, on-device only), Star Register (kids' pretend-store math practice, iPad), Evalve to Independence (a practice register for transition programs, iPad), and The Board (family chore board). Each app has its own privacy policy and support page, for example https://evalveconsulting.com/behavior-tracker/privacy and https://evalveconsulting.com/behavior-tracker/support.

## Newsletter

Evalve Out Louder: Practical AI for busy teachers and school leaders. Every Friday: one idea, one school example, and one thing to try. Subscribe at https://evalveconsulting.com/subscribe/

## Podcast

Evalve Out Loud: Practical conversations about AI in schools. What's working, what isn't, and one thing to try. Available on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and YouTube.
